The tide & the walk

Spring
tidal walk

Read the estuary with the tide. Observe how tidal water links reed beds, exposed mud, and migrating birds.

Find your walk
↓

Two routes. Different paths through the same estuary.

Raised bank
Reed beds
Exposed mud
Outer causeway
Tidal channel
FIELD NOTES / BANK → MUD → WATER
Illustration, not a route map
A LANDSCAPE THAT CHANGES
The tide shapes
what we can see.

Water falls. Feeding areas emerge.
On the falling tide, exposed mud reveals feeding areas. Look at the relationship between the water, the mud, and migrating birds.

The water also sets the limits.
Reed-bed paths stay on the raised bank. The outer causeway is not step-free and may close when water covers it.

YOUR PATH THROUGH THE ESTUARY
